151183.title: Early Morning After a Storm at Sea
151183.creator: Winslow Homer

source.institution: Cleveland Museum of Art, Open Access

editorial.note: Winslow Homer's studio in Prouts Neck, Maine, is a National Historic Landmark.

This painting is a highlight of Dutch Romanticism. It represents the insignificance of man in the face of nature. During a storm, a three-master has struck a rock and foundered. The crew desperately combs the beach in search of survivors.
